notes.title: Hotfix #3 | STAFF UP! Update - Host Staff Balance, UI Quality of Life and more!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dwarves! 🍻

Thank you for your ongoing patience and support! We've got here a patch for balance changes, a ton of quality of life and some bug fixes! We are still currently investigating bugs relating to player de-syncs and animation lag. Rest assured we are working hard to make sure those get fixed!

For now, enjoy this little patch we have prepared for you!

[h3]⚒️ Balance Changes[/h3]
- Added: Stop/Start Working! Action for the Host Staff
- Nerfed: Overall speed of the Host Staff
     * Base Speed: 170 (from 200)
     * Level 1 Speed: 185 (from 230)
     * Level 2 Speed: 200 (from 280)
     * Level 3 Speed: 230 (from 330)
     * Level 4 Speed: 270 (from 390)
     * Level 5 Speed: 300 (from 435)
- Adjusted: The "Ex-Master Tavernkeep" achievement to now only require 20 pulled renowned customers (from 40).

[h3]🎉 Quality of Life & Fun![/h3]
- Added: Throwable bouncy Dwarf Plushies all over the tavern! Find a cuddly buddy for you in-game today 👀
- Added: Profanity Filter (applies to Tavern Names and In-Game Chat)
- Added: Prompt when returning to main menu that shows if you were Kicked from your last server by the host rather than disconnected.
- Added: Small parkour in the staff room.
- Added: The ability to close all interfaces with the ESCAPE key.
- Adjusted: Host Staff movement speed animation scaling to better match their speed.
- Added: Unique sound cue from each staff member when interacting with them.

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed: An issue where occasionally a player cannot move anymore due to being stuck in a diving state.
- Fixed: An issue with an area in the map that could make customers get suck in them.
- Fixed: An issue where the "Plushie Dwarf" skin was in the wrong lootbox and category.
- Fixed: An issue with collision on the ceiling of the staff room.
- Fixed: An occasional crash relating to items.
- Fixed: An issue where pressing escape while using in-game chat could soft-lock your movement.
- Fixed: An issue where you were not given default emotes when loading a new save.

[h3]🧸LESS THAN TWO DAYS LEFT to get your Makeship Tavern Dwarf Plushie[/h3]

Thank you all for your incredible support for our new collaboration plushie with Makeship! There is now less than two days left and only 20 more sales required for it to be successfully crowdfunded!

Make sure to check out the campaign page, and if you were wanting to buy one for yourself, this may be your last chance!

notes.title: Hotfix #2 | STAFF UP! Update - Bug Fixes, Desyncs & more!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dwarves! 🍻

Thank you for your ongoing patience and support! We've been hard at work tackling those pesky bugs we didn't get around to the last hotfix, notably related to player de-syncs. Your feedback on Discord has been invaluable, and we're actively addressing each report to enhance the game, one step at a time. Keep them coming!

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed: A major issue that caused the host player to desync to clients, appearing invisible despite being able to play normally.
- Fixed: Uncommon crashes caused by the player's shuffling inventory.
- Fixed: A crash caused by an invalid Item in a player's hand.
- Fixed: A bug where having a stowed tool on your back caused it to collide with thrown items.

notes.title: Hotfix #1 | STAFF UP! Update - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dwarves! 🍻

We're glad to see you're all enjoying the update so far! This hotfix addresses several of the issues reported, though a couple of connection problems remain. We’re working on another hotfix to resolve those soon.

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed: Common, random crash that was caused by expiring buffs on customers.
- Fixed: Issue where patrolling staff (Fairy & Bard) did not function on Expansion 2.
- Fixed: Issue with collisions in the hearth that prevented players from diving into it.
- Fixed: A case where diving prevented players from moving.
- Fixed: Issue where other staff members stopped each other from interacting with one target (e.g. Fairy blocking the Bard on a customer).
- Fixed: Issue where the Crude Snack VFX was being played on local space rather than world space.
- Fixed: Issue where the Bard Coin spawn effect did not have attenuation, being heard from across the tavern.

[h3]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h3]
- Buffed: Golemite movement speed by 200%
- Buffed: Golemite Level 3 Upgrade Cook Time (from: 15 seconds to: 10 seconds)
- Buffed: Golemite Level 5 Upgrade Cook Time (from: 10 seconds to: 4 seconds)

[h3]🎉 Quality of Life[/h3]
- Adjusted: Emote Pack & Wild West DLC graphics to better represent the contents inside.
- Adjusted: Moved the table at the back of the base expansion to prevent stains & bard coins falling behind it.
- Adjusted: Reworded the Master Tavernkeep Achievement to better relay the information on pulled renowned customers.
- Added: 20 New Staff First Names and 20 New Staff Last Names for each staff member.

notes.title: MAJOR Update #12 STAFF UP! - Staff Members, UI Reworks and more!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dwarves! 🍻

[b]The Staff Have Arrived – And They're Ready to Work![/b]

Grab your applications and clear the schedule – [b]The STAFF UP update is here[/b], and your tavern is about to get a whole lot busier (and smarter). Whether it’s entertaining guests, washing dishes, or bonking skeletons, each new hire brings their own flair to the chaos. It’s time to build your dream team!

[previewyoutube=kBj8fgwNIYY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]What's New?[/h2]

[h2][b]Staff Members![/b][/h2]
Staff Members are the next step towards the end game of Bronzebeard's Tavern. With the expense of your bills and tavern money to upgrade them, they provide invaluable service specializing in their own abilities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/b9096dda0f0640941c4a64c708731224c4cc0fbc.png[/img]

[b][u]The Bard[/u] [/b] 🎵
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/fabea5fc983366ab1427615bfcc6dcf943e40028.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/413ea20051585d0c1ebeed6f3588ce91934f44d2.png[/img][/url]
The Bard is here! Equipped with a lute and his incredible songwriting skills, this fancy dwarf is here to help you handle swarms of customers in the most intense of days. When your customers are impatient, he will be there with entertainment for all.

[b][u]The Golem[/u][/b] 🗿
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/a74f9f4d503662be4f09f8efee39537588f9860e.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/e6e024a03738c52bd854e7a93184b34b65bd39fd.png[/img][/url]
Darn those devious little skellies stealing your beans left and right… This just won't do! Welcome, the Golem! This tall rocky fellow is here to stand dutiful guard, and… serve grub?

[b][u]Host[/u][/b] 🪶
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/5a9a16d7e530eefeaddab0b903838d64c4c11491.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/d14146785764b1e20ee9cc8af289b7ba58b21e66.png[/img][/url]
You know him, the humble front desk host, here with a whole new look and a whole new set of knowledge! Set different seating priorities and watch him guide each guest to their table with exact precision.

[b][u]Fairy[/u][/b] 🧚‍♀️
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/db091c0716751ec2056dfa1d1e63453b03ac9a81.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/6e64741fbc98194768d9e02da804b2268b5d5cc9.png[/img][/url]
Ever struggled balancing four tickets at once? This talented fairy has come to solve your woes, moving order requests and washing stray dishes with the power of magic!

[b]The Staff Room[/b]
Here comes a new expansion to your tavern! A place where one can relax, recruit, and organise staff before the beginning of the next busy day.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/7db960f75b928e8e88abc110108331208eb10797.png[/img]

[h2]UI Improvements[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/1cf6b9cb8d3dac1196d81286b8ea9e3dd40c3779.png[/img]

- Minimized various HUD elements to improve screen visibility and reduce clutter.
- Updated the [b]Ready Up[/b] window – it’s no longer a screen-hog and now subtly does its job.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/1b99f018bde9de416e9857b61730b609801d5f86.png[/img]

- Updated the [b]Stamina Bar[/b] with a cleaner look and improved readability.
- Updated the [b]Open Tavern Time Bar [/b]to a more polished display.
- Updated the [b]Emote Wheel[/b] to include more space for unlockable emotes 
- Replaced old UI headers to better match the new visual style and maintain consistency across elements.
- Replaced and added new Customer Icons

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/8ff397c7d1944743a14ba296f90910275a1def5a.png[/img]

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]🆕 New Features[/h3]
- Added: Staff Members! Bard, Golem, Host and Fairy.
- Added: Staff Room
- Reworked: Skeleton Thieves
- Added: Thief Variant - Skeleton Brute
- Added: Thief Variant - Skeleton Chaser

- Reworked: In-Game UI

- Added: New Emotes!
- Reworked: Emote System

- Added: 19 new Achievements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/5689ccf900fba2cce504a74c708004d18d2d8c07.png[/img]


[h3]🎩 Cosmetics[/h3]
- Adjusted: The look of Weirdbeard's Wonders (the Customization area).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/87d059daca5af90efdccfe3039c372f1c7337118.png[/img]

[h3]Eldritch Horror Mini Pack[/h3]

The Eldritch Horror Mini Pack invites creeping dread and arcane style into your tavern. Adorn your dwarf with mysterious, otherworldly accessories drawn from the depths of forgotten realms. With eerie elegance and a hint of madness, this pack is perfect for those who dare to embrace the unknown. Let the cosmic horror begin!

3x Exclusive Cosmetics
- Whisperhood (Animated)
- Hollowhorn Helm
- Crystal Gaze

3x Exclusive Skins
- Abyssal Layers

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650750/Bronzebeards_Tavern__Eldritch_Horror_Mini_Pack/]Check it out![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/1cf5707b43d8f0454e3c745beb40f4c29bbdcf27.png[/img]

[h3]Wild West Mini Pack[/h3]

The Wild West Mini Pack brings rootin'-tootin' flair to your dwarven getup with frontier fashion, dusty duds, and outlaw-approved accessories. Whether you're a saloon sharpshooter or a gold-hungry gambler, it’s time to saddle up, pour a stiff one, and show the tavern who’s boss. Giddy up, partner!

- Giddy up!

- Cowgirl Hat

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650640/Bronzebeards_Tavern__Wild_West_Mini_Pack/?beta=0]Check it out![/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/2124cd299f081939980d0cdaef267b4770b6e6c8.png[/img]

[h3]Emote Pack[/h3]

The Emote Pack brings four new ways to show off your dwarf’s true feelings. Shush the noisy ones, get gobsmacked by something amazing, drop a cheeky fart, or deliver a world-class facepalm—no words needed. Whether you're causing mischief or reacting to it, this pack’s got you covered from stink to stunned!

4x Exclusive Emotes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/228cf61f9c6b1d85534ef2d6eb7dade48c7471bb.png[/img]

- Whatchu Talkin’bout
- Toot
- Shh!
- OMG!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3650660/Bronzebeards_Tavern__Emote_Pack/?beta=0]Check it out![/url]

[b]Makeship x BBT Event Shop[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44278131/77ef6f0fafc194e10602dd351449f9f6f2c5f7c1.png[/img]

You can now grab this cuddly companion from the Event Shop and carry him proudly on your shoulder. He may be small, but he’s full of cheer and ready to tag along on all your tavern adventures!

1x Cosmetic
- Tavern Dwarf Plushie

[b]Community Loot Box[/b]
It took us long enough but we’ve finally added the cosmetics from our Community Competition! Find them in the brand new Community Loot Box which also features three brand new emotes.

3x Cosmetics
- Bonk Bonk
- Pothead
- Heavy Helm

3x Emotes
- Confused..?
- Surprised
- Dwarf Shuffle

[h3]⚖️ Balance Changes[/h3]
- Added: The Tool Slot - Pressing "R" now allows you to stow tools in your offhand, removing the requirement of it needing to be in your inventory.
- Added: Menu Bonus - A new mechanic that scales the amount of money you gain from customers if you utilize multiple bundles.
- Rework: Employee of the Day - Tweaked values of employee of the day to make it feel more fair. Buffed the chef and hearth positions, added points for more actions such as killing skeletons, washing dishes, etc..
- Rework: Skeleton Thief spawning, now increases in difficulty with rating and has spawn rate increased the lower in power the hearth is.
- Adjusted: Expansion 2 moved closer to the main tavern to prevent too much movement and have easier service.
- Buff: Increased hammer swing speed.
- Buff: Removed expansion scaling when unlocking each expansion.
- Buff: Decreased the stamina usage for diving, as well as strengthening its force allowing you to move further!

[h3]🎉 Quality of Life[/h3]
- Rework: UI, adjusted a lot of the in-game UI for easier readability.
- Adjusted: Item Cycle, items now do not automatically cycle from your back to your main hand on use.
- Adjusted: Lobby Search Parameters, now allowing players to show all active servers regardless of download region.
- Added: Customer Buff Icons. Effects such as the Gobbler and Table buffs show an icon with a visual on how long they last above the customer.
- Improved: Lights that guide you for when the tavern is out of power.

[h3]🐛 Bug Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed: A bug where the DLC NPC's outfit swap was heard across the entire tavern regardless of distance.
- Fixed: Issue that prevented the "Interact" key from being rebound.
- Fixed: Issue where a customer permanently followed a player that had disconnected from the tavern until losing patience.
- Fixed: Issue where sales did not appear on Day 1.
- Fixed: Issue where in some cases, players will be kicked out of the lobby on join.
- Fixed: Invalid Customer Name, when joining late the name of the customer did not properly display.
- Fixed: Issue where customers can have the same name.
- Fixed: Issue where throwing an item while touching the ticket rack does not add it.
- Fixed: Exploit where you can spam the Lute whilst standing on a stain.
- Fixed: Issue with Spookbeard's Tavern beard texture not assigned in one of its cosmetics.
- Fixed: Crash relating to tickets.
- Fixed: Exploit where you could duplicate items from countertops.
- Fixed: Bug where skeletons caused a crash on death.
- Fixed: Bug where skeletons spawned in walls.

[h2]Tavern Dwarf Plush![/h2]

notes.title: Update #5 Steam Presence and Networking Fixes | December 07th 2023
notes.notes:
Hey Dwarves! We've been hard at work for the past two days, listening and now addressing the most major issues with networking right now! Heading into the tavern will be much easier for you and your friends from now on and it will only get better!

As well as this, we've made a couple of small changes such as vanity and updates relating to Discord's rich presence. Once we confirm the stability of networking, we can 100% focus into the bugs affecting the actual tavern!

[u]Netplay and Sessions:[/u]
- Added support for inviting through Steam.
- Added support for joining your friends directly through Steam.
- Added menu to invite players when in-game.

- Fixed an issue where LAN users couldn't find other servers.
- Fixed an issue where LAN games prevented the user from joining.
- Fixed an issue where you couldn't play LAN while Steam was open.

- Fixed an issue where sessions do not appear in the server browser.
- Fixed an issue where players couldn't join through non-password protected servers.
- Fixed an issue where non-password protected servers weren't being advertised properly.

- Partially fixed an issue where you couldn't match-make with players in other regions (use the steam invite system as a workaround).

[u]Gameplay Changes:[/u]
- Adjusted the hitbox of the crude snack to not overlap with the Food Menu.
- Adjusted the hitbox of all tables to block items from going under them.

[u]Vanity Changes:[/u]
- Added size variation to standard customers.
- Added and adjusted customer names.
- Added random customer names for renowned customers.

[u]Discord Support:[/u]
- Added support for Discord

Help Us!
If you have any feature ideas or have experienced any bugs/crashes or have any general suggestions for the game we'd [b]LOVE[/b] to hear it! Please join the discord server below!
https://discord.gg/D5QFcZt3aX We have more planned changes and fixes coming soon so stay tuned... Enjoy the Tavern!
